blurb: Guests can play 18 holes of mini golf, enjoy carnival games, roller skating or ice skating seasonally, dine at rooftop restaurants, and attend events in various rooftop venues. The Roof includes Skyline Park, RFD Social, 9 Mile Station, and private event spaces. It offers a mix of casual and upscale dining, bars, and entertainment with panoramic views of Atlanta's skyline.
